preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain control of owner account)
Attacker needs some tokens to perform a trade that will incur high fees

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setBuyTaxes() or setSelTaxes() with extremely high fee percentages (e.g., 99% each). Then perform a token swap through the DEX pair to trigger fee collection. The high fees will be collected in the contract and can be withdrawn to marketing/team wallets (which the owner controls) or through swapAndLiquify mechanism that sends BNB to owner-controlled addresses.
